content.title: Document and build: independent git worktree
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md

After the spec deviations are fixed and validated (issues mpd4hktoxq and mpd4hs14zp), prepare the release:

**Documentation updates:**
1. Update README.md — add agt push and agt pull commands to CLI quick start section. Add note about worktree-based storage in the 'How it works' section.
2. Update CLI docs — add push/pull command reference (flags, output format, error codes)
3. Re-generate API docs (TypeDoc HTML + Markdown) to include new worktree types and commands

**Build:**
1. Run bun run build in packages/library/ to produce updated dist/
2. Verify the build includes all new modules (worktree.ts, push.ts, pull.ts)
3. Verify the CLI binary works end-to-end (agt --help shows push/pull)
4. Run quality gates (typecheck, lint, tests) to confirm clean build

**Output verification:**
- docs/html/ updated with worktree module docs
- docs/md/ updated with worktree module docs
- dist/ contains the new modules
- agt push --help and agt pull --help work correctly

content.content: After validation passes on mpd4hs14zp: (1) README.md needs agt push and agt pull in CLI quick start, (2) TypeDoc needs regeneration to pick up new worktree.ts types (WorktreeInitResult, WorktreeSyncResult, WorktreePullResult) and push/pull CLI commands, (3) build must include worktree module in dist/. The spec has exact output formats for all commands — use those for documentation.

content.reason: Blocker issue mpd4hs14zp transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. All documentation and build tasks completed:

**Quality gates:** typecheck ✓, lint ✓, 649 tests passing ✓ (0 failures)

**Documentation updates:**
1. README.md — added 'Git worktree sync' to features list, added agt push/pull to CLI quick start, added Sync section with examples, added Worktree Sync API programmatic docs, updated 'How It Works' section to describe worktree-based storage
2. commands.md — added full push/pull command reference (flags, output format, error codes, examples), added new error codes (NOT_A_GIT_REPO, MIGRATION_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE, PUSH_FAILED, PULL_FAILED) to global errors
3. TypeDoc — regenerated both HTML and Markdown docs. docs/html/ and docs/md/ now include all worktree types (WorktreeInitResult, WorktreeSyncResult, WorktreePullResult) and functions (initWorktree, pushWorktree, pullWorktree, etc.)

**Build verification:**
- bun run build → successful (index.js, index.cjs, bin.js, type declarations)
- dist/ includes worktree module (33 references verified)
- agt --help shows push and pull commands
- agt push --help and agt pull --help display correct flags

**No version bump applied** — version stays at 0.1.0 as this is a pre-release feature addition.
